overview: The Traffic Commission approved a residential handicap parking space and a parking variance for Main Street residents. The body also implemented parking restrictions on Washington Street and Governors Avenue to improve sightlines and protect public infrastructure.

items.title: 77 Lawrence Street Handicap Parking Space
items.summary: Approved a handicap parking space for a resident with significant mobility and medical needs after determining the existing driveway was too narrow for a motorized wheelchair ramp.

items.title: Tabled Handicap Parking Requests
items.summary: Tabled requests for handicap parking signs at 219 Salem Street, 149 Middlesex Avenue, and 36 Fourth Avenue because the applicants were not present to answer questions about driveway access.

items.title: 383 Main Street Parking Variance
items.summary: Approved a variance allowing two vehicles from 383 Main Street to park in the G resident parking zone because the property faces a metered section of Main Street.

items.title: Washington Street and Dudley Street Sightlines
items.summary: Approved extending the "No Parking" zones at the corners of Washington Street and Dudley Street to improve visibility and address safety concerns regarding accidents and speeding.

items.title: Governors Avenue Parking Restriction
items.summary: Approved removing approximately 20 feet of parking on the east side of Governors Avenue to prevent exiting vehicles from driving over the landscaped median.

items.title: Contraflow Lane Project Updates
items.summary: Commissioners discussed implementation delays for the Park Street contraflow lane due to poor pavement conditions and noted the Clippership lane is undergoing conservation review.
